[ASSISTANT_SAID] A 1TB hard drive is a reasonable price and provides ample storage, but an SSD would improve performance further.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] SSDs are faster than HDDs, with read/write speeds of up to 500-1000 MB/s compared to HDDs' 100-200 MB/s.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] SSDs have faster access times (0.1-0.2 milliseconds) compared to HDDs (5-10 milliseconds).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] SSDs are more durable and reliable due to having no moving parts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] SSDs consume less power, leading to longer battery life in laptops.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] SSDs are silent, while HDDs can generate noise.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] SSDs are becoming more affordable and are catching up in capacity compared to HDDs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should consider using an SSD as the primary drive and keeping the HDD as a secondary drive for storage.
